title: §.XII continue: Walther oath text — sound Gospel doctrine in three Symbols & AC 1530; reject heresies
pass_a_gloss: I, Master Christian Walther, swear that I will hand on and defend the sound Doctrine of the Gospel of Christ and of the word of the Prophets and Apostles — whose heads are held comprehended and explained in the three Symbols and in the Confession exhibited to Charles V at Augsburg — as rightly known, so diligently and faithfully kept; that I will carefully and according to my strength decline and impugn all false, Heretical dogmas and those fighting with the manifest word of God, of both the old and the new Arians, and of other Fanatical men:
pass_b_english: I, Master Christian Walther, swear that I will hand on and defend the sound doctrine of Christ's Gospel and of the Prophets' and Apostles' word — whose chief points are contained and explained in the three Symbols and in the Confession shown to Charles V at Augsburg — knowing it rightly and keeping it diligently and faithfully.
I will carefully and as far as I can refuse and attack all false and heretical dogmas that fight the clear word of God, whether of old or new Arians or of other fanatics.
source_text: Ego Magister Christianus Walther juro, me sanam Doctrinam Evangelii Christi & verbi Prophetarum & Apostolorum, cujus capita in tribus Symbolis & Confessione, Carolo V. Augustae exhibita, comprehensa & explicata habentur, ut rectè cognitam ita diligenter & fideliter custoditam traditurum ac defensurum; Omnia falsa, Heretica & cum manifesto Dei verbo pugnantia, tam veterum quàm novorum Arrianorum, & aliorum Fanaticorum hominum Dogmata sedulò ac pro virili declinaturum impugnaturumque esse:

lemmas.gloss: Confession exhibited to Charles V at Augsburg
